mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, user_id, report_type, enabled, channels, weekday, send_hour, last_sent_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_subscription WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND report_type = #{reportType}
SELECT FROM report_subscription WHERE report_type = #{reportType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY workspace_id, user_id
SELECT FROM report_subscription WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND report_type = #{reportType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_subscription (id, workspace_id, user_id, report_type, enabled, channels, weekday, send_hour) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{reportType}, #{enabled}, #{channels}, #{weekday}, #{sendHour}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), channels = VALUES(channels), weekday = VALUES(weekday), send_hour = VALUES(send_hour), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE report_subscription SET last_sent_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM report_subscription WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
